title: Assess declared allocation with explicit rule and scope
statement: The Views and traceability Module shall assess applicable Allocated Requirement and Function responsibilities using exact selected-state facts and declared deciding rules, exposing missing or conflicting allocations, permitted deferrals and unresolved scope without converting mechanical consistency into engineering approval.

what.problem: Derived responsibility or impact results can hide missing scope and be mistaken for stronger engineering conclusions.
what.desired_outcome: Assess declared allocation with explicit rule and scope.

why.rationale: SR-010 requires an accountable result owner preserving its exact finding and completeness semantics.

conditions: A participant requests the corresponding analysis in one selected model state.

contexts: MOD-004 logical analysis boundary using IF-001/IF-002 and its internal traversal contribution.

how.approach: Bind explicit request and source identities, derive attributable results, preserve unknown or limited scope, and leave stronger judgments with their owners.

how_much.scope: The MOD-004 result obligation for all five SR-010 criteria; content custody, profile interpretation and general traversal retain existing owners and ARs.

acceptance_criteria: For each selected applicable AR or Function, establish declared rule applicability and required ownership; identify missing responsibility and preserve only explicitly permitted deferrals with their source and conditions.
For every relevant AR-to-Function constraint, preserve both allocation paths, known or unresolved owner identities, authored provenance and the deciding rule basis.

Report a violation only where complete relevant facts and an applicable rule decide it; differing ownership without such a rule remains an engineering review question, including unsupported or conflicting rule meaning.

Inspect complete required membership, incoming constraints and architecture context; expose unmodeled, unavailable, ambiguous or interrupted scope and retain known findings without claiming complete consistency.

Keep acquisition/evaluation completeness, consistent facts, violations, deferrals and review questions distinguishable; no result invents allocation, creates an AR, approves architecture or establishes satisfaction.
constraints: Proposed architecture only; no runtime availability, implementation or verification claim.

sources.basis: Derive rule-bound allocation assessment and scope-bound potential-impact result contracts with distinct MOD-004 obligations. Reuse content, interpretation and traversal ownership; proposed Design only.
